utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right—I heard the repair drive is still happening this week. I’ll keep an eye out for any updates when I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, thanks. Let me know if you see any sign-up sheets or pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out later today, so I’ll check for any sign-up sheets or posted pickup times and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, what’s the latest on the repair drive? I’ve been a bit busy and may have missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still collecting a few things, but it’s moving along. I’ll let you know when we’re ready to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Leo — just give me a heads-up when it’s time to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, just to confirm — this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off plan are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, got it — so it’s still on. When do you want the drop-off to happen?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just tell me what needs fixing and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got a few broken things to sort out, and I’ll bring them by once I’ve made a proper list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—no rush. Just let me know when the list’s ready, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Just to make sure I’ve got it right, what exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think it’s the usual stuff around the block that needs fixing, and the drive’s happening soon—I just don’t have the exact time in front of me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—when you have the exact time and list of repairs, send them over so I can make sure I’m clear on everything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late as usual, but I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — could you help sort donations and hand out supplies when people arrive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can sort donations and hand out supplies when folks show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help organize the tool sign-out and maybe lend a hand with the first few repairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can organize the tool sign-out and help with the first few repairs. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the repair drive locations and see where things are set up. What do you need to know?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal—could you check which location is closest to the school pickup route and what times they’re accepting donations?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check that and let you know the closest spot to the school pickup route, plus their donation hours.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s getting pretty good turnout already—folks are dropping off all kinds of odds and ends. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—I'd love to hear what’s still needed. I can spread the word around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—right now they could really use hand tools, extension cords, and any spare bike parts folks aren’t using. I’d say tell everyone to check their sheds and garages!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, how’s the repair drive going—do you still need any tools or hands on deck?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, a couple hands would still help if anyone’s free. I could also use a wrench set and a drill if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring a wrench set and help out for a bit—what time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ve told a few folks about the repair drive already. I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure they know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—if you hear any updates, could you let me know? I’ve been trying to keep track second-hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I will. I’ll pass along any updates I hear about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start a simple list of what needs fixing and who can help. If you spot any urgent repairs, tell me and I’ll add them right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll let you know if I see anything urgent around my place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated and we can tackle the biggest items first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and cash all morning. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to ask around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to hear. I’ll make a quick list and see what needs fixing most.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great idea—start with the leaky stuff and anything that’s been giving you trouble for a while. If you want, I can ask around and see who needs help most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, you didn’t miss much yet—we’re still just getting organized. I was telling folks we’ll probably start collecting donations and volunteers this week.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help spread the word and chip in if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I could use help with a few small fixes around the house, if anyone’s willing. I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with a few small fixes. Just let me know what needs doing, and I’ll see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive—yeah, I saw something about it. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m just trying to figure out where the repair drive is being held and what time it starts. If you know the location, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure on the exact spot or start time, but I think it’s at the community center. I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive going—should I help spread the word to the other folks on the block?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please do—just make sure they know it’s for the repair drive and not a regular block meetup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll make it clear it’s for the repair drive. I’ll spread the word to the neighbors now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’ve been a bit out of it; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: If you can, bring any spare tools, tape, or small appliances people want fixed. And if you know anyone handy, send them my way too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring what I have and ask around for anyone handy. If I remember anything else useful, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s coming along pretty well—folks have been dropping off tools and a few supplies already. I can swing by later and tell you what still needs to be filled in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Gus—come by later and let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the loose gate latch and a busted porch step.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I can take the gate latch and help patch up that porch step.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should double-check the pickup time and who’s bringing the tools first. I’d rather not have us scrambling at the last minute.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good idea—what time is the pickup, and who’s bringing the tools?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not sure yet—let’s confirm the pickup time with the organizer, and maybe we can ask Leo if he’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it already—if you want, I can swing by and invite a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Quinn—thanks. I’m keeping track of supplies, so the more folks know, the better.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word today and point them your way for supplies. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate, but I need the school schedule first so I can see what time works for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I don’t have the school schedule yet, but I’ll get it and bring it over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that works. Bring it over when you have it, and I’ll line up a time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help coordinate the repair drive. Let’s gather the list of needed fixes and make a plan for the block.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m glad you’re coordinating it. I’ll ask around and send you any repair requests I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Nell — thank you. Send them my way, and I’ll start organizing everything into a simple plan.
